scenes.say: A bird’s wing is a modified forelimb. Its feathered surface helps generate lift and, during active flapping, thrust. A flight quill has a stiff shaft and an interlocking vane. Wing quills make much of the aerodynamic surface.

A long narrow bill can reach nectar inside a tubular flower. Hummingbird bill shapes vary with the flowers they visit. A short stout bill can withstand the force needed to crack seeds, as in some finches.
The curved talons on a hunting bird’s feet close around prey and hold it while the bird feeds.
For JAMB, match the quill feather to flight, a narrow bill to reaching nectar, and a short stout bill to crushing seed. The blue arrows show the wing stroke, bill approach and grip.

quickCheck.prompt: Which structure lets a raptor hold prey?
quickCheck.feedback: The curved claws on a raptor’s feet grasp and hold prey.
